data.content: Plan (effort 1): 1. Refresh this implementation worktree to current remote main before code changes, preserving the active claim and using the repository worktree branch. 2. Add a focused compaction protocol module with public version-2 manifest/checkpoint types, strict path/digest/count/object-id/cutoff validation inputs, deterministic canonical generation identity, predecessor-chain validation, and pure publication-state transitions. 3. Keep snapshot database loading and remote publication integration outside this knot; expose validated data and protocol decisions for knots-5728 and knots-2af8. 4. Add unit tests for valid prepared/active generations, malformed or incomplete snapshot pairs, unsupported protocol/state, bad hashes/lengths/counts/paths/object IDs, generation-id mismatch, invalid cutoff ancestry/tree resolution, predecessor cycles/skips, interrupted prepare, activation races, and rollback to the verified predecessor. 5. Run focused tests, formatting/lint, then make sanity without lowering coverage; commit, attribute, and ship through the repository rail. Risks: canonical serialization drift and confusing Git resolution with pure schema checks. Mitigation: a documented fixed field order, identity test vectors, and injected source/cutoff facts so tests remain deterministic.
